purpose: Publish the current deterministic-eligible Steam KZ catalogue while three independent GitHub-owned stages progress: provisional Fast analysis (PASS 1), neutral Dossier preparation, and eventual authoritative Deep analysis (technical PASS 2) for every current eligible game.

state_projection.analyzed_fit: exact-compatible trustworthy accepted INCLUDE with fit strong or moderate and the selected existing business scenario still INCLUDE
state_projection.analyzed_not_fit: exact-compatible trustworthy completed semantic EXCLUDE where current fit-evidence semantics establish a completed not-fit rather than missing evidence
state_projection.analysis_incomplete: only when current canonical evidence proves an attempt/outcome is incomplete without trustworthy fit/not-fit
state_projection.not_analyzed: default for no trustworthy current semantic outcome, including stale/incompatible results
state_projection.insufficient_information_rule: missing or insufficient candidate evidence is unresolved and must not be hidden as analyzed_not_fit
state_projection.stale_or_incompatible_rule: never present stale or incompatible Taste as current fit/not-fit
state_projection.pass1_current_exact_result: current exact-bound PASS 1 outcome may project analyzed_fit, analyzed_not_fit, or analysis_incomplete without mutating the canonical V5 Taste cache

sorting.tier_2_3: producer-owned deterministic purchase-only score from the existing purchase component semantics; never total_score

phase_c_pass2_design.purpose: Eventual authoritative Deep analysis for every current eligible Progressive game after exact-compatible canonically accepted Dossier evidence is ready; Fast/PASS 1 is not an eligibility prerequisite.

conditions: item is current and eligible under the Progressive semantic generation/work identity
an exact-compatible canonically accepted current Dossier exists in the GitHub-owned accepted Dossier store
Dossier appid/work/release identity is exact under current Dossier identity rules and its compatibility binding/freshness are current
no current authoritative Deep analyzed_fit/analyzed_not_fit completion exists for this deep work identity
the item is eligible for normal Deep first pass, or has an explicit GitHub-owned recovery authorization under the recovery model
false_if_any: no canonically accepted exact-compatible current Dossier
Dossier exists only as buffered/unaccepted/failed-or-recovery candidate
current semantic_generation_id or work_id no longer matches the authorized Deep identity
current authoritative Deep completion already exists
a failed first pass is recovery-owned but no explicit current recovery condition/authorization exists

normal_first_pass_and_recovery.normal_first_pass_goal: attempt every current eligible deep identity once when its accepted compatible Dossier becomes ready
normal_first_pass_and_recovery.normal_first_pass_success: authoritative Deep analyzed_fit/analyzed_not_fit closes the current deep identity
normal_first_pass_and_recovery.normal_first_pass_unresolved: does not count as authoritative completion; move the exact identity into separate GitHub-owned recovery state without blocking unrelated normal first-pass work
recovery_unlock_conditions: materially_changed canonically accepted Dossier/evidence for the same current deep identity
a corrected runtime/validation defect that materially changes the reason the prior Deep attempt could not complete
an explicit canonical GitHub recovery action with a recorded reason and exact authorization
normal_first_pass_and_recovery.recovery_authorization_rule: Every recovery attempt requires a fresh GitHub-owned authorization bound to the concrete recovery condition. Passage of time, queue presence, or another worker invocation alone never authorizes retry.
normal_first_pass_and_recovery.recovery_history_rule: Recovery attempts and outcomes are accounted separately from the single normal first-pass attempt.
normal_first_pass_and_recovery.unresolved_recovery_rule: If a recovery attempt remains unresolved, return to recovery-owned state and require a new concrete recovery condition/authorization before another recovery attempt.

dossier_contract_dependencies.rule: Deep consumes only canonical accepted Dossier truth and does not redefine Dossier evidence, identity, freshness, recovery, or persistence semantics.

phase_c_pass2_design.activation_guard: Deep/PASS 2 semantic execution remains inactive. The previously prepared recovery-only activation plan is superseded. No Scheduled Deep worker may be created/enabled/run and no Deep backlog may be processed until a separate runtime-adaptation task implements this FAST-DOSSIER-DEEP-V1 architecture and a later Director-accepted activation step authorizes production.

independence_rules: Fast and Deep do not globally wait for each other.
Dossier runs independently and never decides personalized fit/not-fit.
Deep eligibility is unlocked by exact-compatible canonically accepted Dossier evidence, not by Fast completion or Fast analysis_incomplete.
Deep may run before Fast when Dossier is ready.
Completed authoritative Deep suppresses future Fast work for the same current identity.
Completed Fast never suppresses eventual Deep coverage.
A failure in one stage does not globally block another stage or unrelated games.
stage_model.current_identity_rule: All stage authorization and presentation must bind to the current Progressive semantic generation/work identity; stale generation/work authorizations are invalid.

ordered_rules: trustworthy current completed Deep analyzed_fit or analyzed_not_fit is authoritative effective personalized truth
otherwise trustworthy current completed Fast analyzed_fit or analyzed_not_fit may remain the provisional effective personalized truth
otherwise use the existing unresolved/not-analyzed projection
effective_result_precedence.deep_incomplete_or_error_rule: A Deep incomplete/technical failure never erases a still-valid trustworthy Fast fit/not-fit result.
effective_result_precedence.provenance_rule: Fast and Deep stage history remain separate; Deep completion does not rewrite Fast history.
effective_result_precedence.existing_reusable_taste_cache_rule: This amendment does not rewrite the separately canonical reusable Taste cache. Runtime adaptation must keep its existing compatibility rules and must never present such cache reuse as Fast or Deep stage completion unless exact stage provenance exists.

stage_observability.card_indicator_target: Every game card can render three small pixel-style indicators, one per stage, directly from producer-owned fields. Final visual design is deferred.

statistics_page_contract.denominator_rule: Each section uses its own explicitly named current scope. Never combine counts across different scopes into one denominator.

invariants: deep_normal_first_pass_complete and deep_all_current_authoritative_complete are distinct metrics and may differ while recovery-owned items remain
